written_by: Site copy for each campaign key the house engine can switch on. The engine decides when a campaign runs (data/house.json); this file decides how it reads.

retrograde-edit.body: Mercury turns back through the sky. A small edit for the weeks when every message seems to arrive twice.

spring-equinox.body: Day and night stand level and the Sun crosses into Aries, the first sign of the zodiac.

summer-solstice.body: The longest day of the year, and the Sun's turn into Cancer.

autumn-equinox.body: Day and night stand level again as the Sun enters Libra, the sign of the scales.

winter-solstice.body: The shortest day of the year, and the Sun's turn into Capricorn.
